a.speaker: dutch
a.text: Hah... hah. Look at the tote board, kid. Look at those numbers. They love you.

c.speaker: dutch
c.text: Vance paid. Vance always pays. But Vance didn't sign the change order.

e.speaker: dutch
e.text: Moreno. T. Moreno. Nice handwriting. Loops on the capitals.

g.speaker: dutch
g.text: Maybe. Ask why the sprinklers in here are dry. Same as the extinguishers. Somebody likes a theme.

h.speaker: pa
h.text: THE LINES ARE OPEN, CALIFORNIA! Dial ONE to FINISH HIM. Dial TWO to SPARE HIM. Operators are standing by!

i.speaker: narration
i.text: Above the stage the tote board ticks over. FINISH: 2,114,902. SPARE: 11.

k1.speaker: cass
k1.text: This one's for the viewers at home.

k2.speaker: narration
k2.text: The studio audience applauds. The applause is canned. It goes on a little too long.

s2.speaker: narration
s2.text: She puts a bullet through the nearest camera. Then the next. Then the next. On forty million screens, the picture goes to snow.

s3.speaker: dutch
s3.text: They'll just cut to a commercial, kid. They always cut to a commercial.

e2.speaker: narration
e2.text: He fishes a scorched form out of his suit and presses it into her hand. The signature at the bottom has loops on the capitals.
